distanceRationale: Mathlib has RootPairing, bases, Cartan matrices, Weyl groups and CoxeterSystem. Tau Ceti has built nearly all of Layers 1–6 on top: positive roots and inversions, the Coxeter matrix of a base with the surjection from the presented Coxeter group, strong exchange and Bruhat order, dominant chambers as a fundamental domain, the longest element, the finite-type Cartan-matrix classification into valid Dynkin types with rigidity, and simply connected root data. distanceRationale: Mathlib contributes Young diagrams, partitions and cycle types. Tau Ceti has built Layers 0–5 in full: dominance, Young subgroups and permutation modules, symmetrizers, Specht modules via the submodule theorem, the classification partitionEquivSimpleFDRepClasses, the standard polytabloid basis, and the hook-length formula. distanceRationale: Mathlib proves Artin–Wedderburn existence, Schur's lemma and isotypic decomposition. Tau Ceti has built every remaining layer. That covers invariance of the block count, simple-module classes of the regular module, the double-centralizer theorem, and tensor products of central simple algebras staying simple. It also covers A ⊗ Aᵒᵖ ≅ M_{dim A}(K), the square-dimension theorem, Skolem–Noether, the centralizer theorem, the Brauer group as a commutative group, and finite separable splitting fields, maximal subfields and the index. The roadmap is essentially complete.

distanceRationale: Mathlib defines CliffordAlgebra, pinGroup and spinGroup. Tau Ceti has built Layers 0–4 and much of 5, 7 and 9 on top: the filtration with gr Cliff ≅ ⋀V, the structure theorem via polarizations, and Pin/Spin double covers with ℤ/2 kernels and the spinor-norm sequence. Still missing: Spin₄ ≅ SL₂×SL₂, Spin₅ ≅ Sp₄ and Spin₆ ≅ SL₄, triality as an outer automorphism of Spin₈, and the general Kostant isotypy corollary with its multiplicities.

distanceRationale: Mathlib supplies the triangulated homotopy and derived categories and localization. Tau Ceti adds part of Layer 0: Quillen exact structures with a Frobenius predicate, the morphism-ideal quotient, and DG right modules. Nothing beyond that exists. Matrix factorizations with HMF and Orlov's comparison are missing too. That is several layers, the later ones research-level.

distanceRationale: Tau Ceti has built the strict-algebra half on its path-algebra API: doubled quivers, zigzag algebras with bases, dimensions, centers, nondegenerate trace pairings and self-injectivity, and graded Cartan matrices for D₄, E₈ and affine E₈. It also has additive preprojective algebras with gauge, opposite and orientation independence, plus A∞ algebras only at the level of Stasheff identities. The derived half is absent: quadratic/Koszul duality and Etingof–Eu Koszulity, 2- and 3-dimensional Ginzburg DG algebras and Calabi–Yau completions, Hochschild cohomology with minimal A∞ deformations and Liu–Wang intrinsic formality, and Khovanov–Seidel braid actions. Those are several research-level layers resting on a largely unbuilt DG/A∞ sibling roadmap.
